status: frozen before instrumented solver build or execution
purpose: Reconstruct actual pressure/velocity correction at matched calls without approximating rAtU by dt
record_after_velocity_assignment: U before boundary and fvConstraints operations
identity: U_before_constraints = HbyA - rAtU*grad(p) at the same correction call
identity_tolerance: Relative L2 residual <=1e-12, and absolute max residual <=1e-12*max(1,max_abs_U,max_abs_HbyA,max_abs_correction)
pilot: Use a separate copy of the existing n16 case; compare uninstrumented and instrumented endpoint U,p,phi byte-for-byte before trusting diagnostics. No physics or solver dictionary changes.
provenance: Retain source patch, compiled library identity, exact loaded-library path, call/time tags, exit states, all failed pilots. Do not overwrite installed library.
scope: Endpoint algebra only. No accumulated-history attribution from final-call output. If pilot changes endpoint outputs, stop and diagnose instrumentation before larger runs.
